curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when prisoners are taken to Unit 731 for experiments tied to biological weapons?
curatedMovie.description: Chinese and Russian prisoners of war are taken by Japanese troops to Unit 731 for experiments involving biological weapons.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, grim, and intensely harrowing historical horror best faced alone with complete focus.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This history-horror account confronts the imprisonment and experimentation of prisoners at Unit 731.
